name: for-people-no-friend
description: A local-first Windows AI character companion built with Electron, TypeScript, and Vite.

scripts.build: pnpm clean && pnpm build:electron && pnpm build:renderer
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite build --config vite.preload.config.mts --watch" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 dist-electron/main/index.js dist-electron/preload/index.cjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm smoke:preload
